A [[Cerean/Legends|Cerean]]''' male''' was the father to [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Ki-Adi-Mundi/Legends|Ki-Adi-Mundi]]. A farmer, he and his family owned their [[Farm/Legends|farm]], where they lived in seclusion with limited technology, as was typical of the Cerean culture. In [[88 BBY/Legends|88 BBY]], he wilingly gave up his son to Jedi Master [[The Dark Woman|An'ya Kuro]] when the latter detected Mundi to be strong in [[The Force/Legends|the Force]].

He died in the [[Battle of Cerea]] in [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]].
